summary: The §8.5/§8.6 projection certificates and the §7 R4/R4′ entries are landed in vendor/truck/truck-certified/src/kernel/projection.rs (wired as kernel::projection in kernel/mod.rs). graphcert implements Theorem 8.3 as a cone test with NO solve: the certified sign of n0 against the patch's normal set over the box is decided by the outward-rounded enclosure of n0·N (N = S_u × S_v) built from the CertifiedPatch derivative enclosures (cross product + dot), after finite-enclosure and finite-normal-cone gates; it refuses with the named predicate graphcert_no_feasible_n0 (Conditioning/Inconclusive) when zero cannot be excluded. n0 feasibility is documented as the §9.1 two-cone LP (tier1_loop_free, cited not forked). r4_project packages the R4 2x2 projection solve (the frozen krawczyk_c1 IS the solver) over a deterministic orthonormal complement basis (e1 × e2 = n0, IEEE-sqrt normalization only); r4_prime packages the R4′ normal-projection residual P(u0; s,t) = (S1_u·(S2−S1), S1_v·(S2−S1)) for a fixed first-patch chart point as the no-feasible-n0 fallback. r5_enclose implements §8.6 step 1 (preimage) verbatim for the reduced shared-chart configuration (both patches graphs over Π, preimage region = the target box): per patch, graphcert over the target region, the §7.1 weight-bound value argument, then C1 on R4 at the target centre; it emits the frozen R5Enclosure { q, preimage, cert } with R4-stamped PointCerts, and refuses with RefusalKind::R5EnclosureFailed (Inconclusive) when any preimage stage cannot be certified (named predicates r5_graphcert_refused_over_target / r5_weight_bound_not_proven / r5_krawczyk_stalled_at_depth_max). Steps 2/3/5 (value, gradient, g = f1 − f2) are exposed as r5_graph_enclose returning R5Graph { value, grad }, with the R5 gradient's interval inversion implemented locally (adjugate/det over the landed CertifiedInterval primitives — stop condition 2 did not need to fire); step 4 (Hessian) is deferred to S5A. The shim R5Enclosure carries no try_new (certs.rs is frozen and outside the write set), so the value is constructed locally after every stage validates. No Bernstein evaluation exists anywhere in the module; no transcendental call appears (the two source audits pin both). The nine required integration tests live in tests/kernel_projection.rs. RESULT.json is at the worktree root.

measured_counts.graphcert_sphere_chart: rational unit-sphere carrier, chart cap box [-0.25,0.25]^2, n0 = polar axis (0,0,1): GraphCert Proven with a strictly positive certified det bound (0 excluded from □(n0·N)); projection injective on the certified box (distinct chart points project distinctly).
measured_counts.graphcert_refusal_tangential_pair: 302 tangential-adjacent family members (sphere cap z = 1 − (u²+v²)/2 and its tangent plane z = 1) with n0 = (1,0,0) over [-1e-3,1e-3]^2: cap returns Conditioning/graphcert_no_feasible_n0 (n0·N = −h_u = u straddles zero); plane returns Conditioning/graphcert_no_feasible_n0 (n0·N exactly zero up to the directed-rounding subnormal floor). Feasible n0 = (0,0,1) certifies both.
measured_counts.r5_preimage_refusal: horizontal plane pair (z = 1) with n0 = (1,0,0) over [-0.2,0.2]^2: r5_enclose refuses RefusalKind::R5EnclosureFailed (Inconclusive), predicate r5_graphcert_refused_over_target; every refinement is also non-graph in the x direction, so the caller subdivides or falls back to R4′.
measured_counts.r4_prime_fallback: 302 tangential-adjacent pair: cap normal at u0 = (0,0) certified to meet the tangent plane z = 1 at the chart origin (Proven, ResidualId::R4Prime, rho <= RHO_MAX, S2A C1 parity identical); cap normal at (0.5,0) meets the tangent plane at (0.5625,0), provably outside the [0.8,1]×[-0.1,0.1] search box — honest non-Proven, never a false Proven.

blocking_finding.text: None. All nine required tests pass; the workspace check (cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked) is green and the full pre-existing truck-certified suite (566 lib + all integration/doc suites) stays green. The only semantic nuance recorded: because the frozen &dyn CertifiedPatch seam exposes no parameter-domain accessor and the frozen R5Enclosure shim has no try_new, r5_enclose operates over the §10.3 reduced shared-chart configuration where the certified preimage region is the target box itself, and R5 preimage failures surface as RefusalKind::R5EnclosureFailed through the refusal-carrying verdict arm (the ClaimVerdict E slot) — both recorded in the module docs. graphcert's zero-exclusion test treats the directed-rounding subnormal floor of an exactly-degenerate graph as the same no-feasible-n0 refusal rather than a separate exact-zero class.
